title: Fireworks on the Field
summary: An early quiet display, the main spectacular and an evening of food, games and family fun.
ticketNote: Book early. Tickets on the gate are subject to availability, and the event usually sells out in advance.

goodToKnow.label: On the night
goodToKnow.text: Fairground games and rides, a parent-run BBQ and bar, a pizza van with gluten-free options, a coffee cart, a braid bar and face painting.

goodToKnow.label: Tokens
goodToKnow.text: Rides and games cost £2 a go and take tokens only. £1 = 1 green or 2 yellow. Tokens can be bought in advance or on the night, and old Ashley tokens still work.

goodToKnow.label: Entry
goodToKnow.text: You need a ticket or organiser pass to get in. Please keep children with you at all times.

goodToKnow.label: Food and payments
goodToKnow.text: The BBQ, bar, pizza van and coffee cart accept cash or card. Bring cash for the braid bar and face painting.

goodToKnow.label: Parking
goodToKnow.text: There is no on-site parking. Limited parking is available around town near the school.

goodToKnow.label: Children
goodToKnow.text: Please keep children with you. Wristbands are provided at the entrance for parents to write their phone number on. Children who cannot find their parents can go to the Harmony Centre for help via the PA.

goodToKnow.label: First aid
goodToKnow.text: St John Ambulance will be in the Hive throughout the event.

goodToKnow.label: Please note
goodToKnow.text: This is a pet, smoke and sparkler-free zone.

schedule.label: Gates open
schedule.detail: Food, games and family activities begin.

schedule.label: Quiet display
schedule.detail: The earlier display is scheduled before the main event.
